doc.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021

title: Who comes to the Arkestra and why
summary: Allen says musicians came to Sun Ra without recruitment and still do; it is about sincerity and well being, not money or fame.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Do you try to continue with that philosophy with the current Arkestra members?

Well everyone that came to Sun Ra came to Sun Ra. He didn’t do much recruiting. You understand? They would come because they wanted to play in his band. So that’s the way it is now. They come when they want — when somebody comes that means the Creator sent somebody to help us out, to do the part. Because they are sincere and they really want to do it. But I don’t have to go out and hire people. You understand?

Because all I do is sit here and what I need will come, it will come along. And that said, being sincere and open minded and really want to do it. And it’s not about money or fame or all of that stuff. It’s about your well being and the well being for those who you play for. Music is a language.
Yeah. Over the years I would assume that there was members in the group that really embraced Sun Ra’s equations, and then some members who didn’t so much.

Well that’s just like why it’s a natural thing. That’s the way America is. Some people believe in democracy and others believe something else. So all of those that believe in something that’s better for being wins. You know?
Because that’s the way it is. It’s just like life is. You know?
